Name: Jianying Pro
Description: Shortcut, timeline and color controls for Jianying Pro.

Actions.Name: Shortcut
Actions.Tooltip: Run a Jianying Pro editing shortcut.

Actions.Name: Timeline Control
Actions.Tooltip: Turn to control the timeline; hold and turn to switch functions.

Actions.Name: Adjust Selected Slider
Actions.Tooltip: Hover a supported slider, turn to adjust, and press to reset. Basic: Temperature, Tint, Saturation, Vibrance, Brightness, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites, Blacks, Exposure, Sharpen, Clarity, Grain, Fade, and Vignette. HSL: Hue, Saturation, and Brightness for Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue, Purple, and Magenta.

Actions.Name: Color Wheels
Actions.Tooltip: Hover over intensity or any color wheel; turn to adjust and press to reset.

Localization.Basic hover help: Open Adjustments → Basic in Jianying, then move the pointer over any Basic parameter row. Turn the dial after the cyan frame appears; visible parameters are detected again after scrolling.
Localization.HSL hover help: Open Adjustments → HSL in Jianying and select a color, then move the pointer over Hue, Saturation, or Luminance. Turn after the cyan frame appears; press the dial to reset the hovered parameter.
Localization.Selected slider hover help: Move the pointer over a supported slider in Adjustments → Basic or HSL. Turn after the cyan corners appear; press to reset. Basic: Temperature, Tint, Saturation, Vibrance, Brightness, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites, Blacks, Exposure, Sharpen, Clarity, Grain, Fade, and Vignette. HSL: Hue, Saturation, and Brightness for Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue, Purple, and Magenta.
Localization.Color wheel hover help: Open Adjustments → Color Wheels in Jianying, then move the pointer over Intensity or any wheel. Turn after the cyan corners appear; press the dial to reset the hovered control.
Localization.Shortcut fallback: Jianying shortcuts could not be read; built-in shortcuts are being used.
Localization.Shortcut unassigned help: This function has no shortcut in Jianying. Assign one in Jianying's shortcut settings, then refresh.
Localization.Shortcut troubleshooting: If this action does not work, check Jianying's shortcut settings. If they differ, change or add the shortcut shown above.
Localization.Cycle parameters help: Select the parameters that a dial tap cycles through; turning adjusts only the current parameter.
Localization.Calibration help: Capture the screen position of the current value or slider. Turning drags it; holding the dial resets it with a double-click.
Localization.Capture help: Click, then move the pointer onto the Jianying value or slider and keep it still.
Localization.Panel linkage help: Capture the Basic, HSL, or Color Wheels entry if it must be opened before adjustment.
Localization.Jianying Pro not detected. Open Jianying: Jianying Pro was not detected. Open Jianying Pro and the plugin will reconnect automatically.
Localization.Plugin connection lost. Jianying status: Plugin connection lost. Jianying status cannot be checked.
Localization.Gesture help: Tap to switch parameters, hold to reset, and hold while turning for fine adjustment.
Localization.Fast forward: Move forward a large step in the timeline
Localization.Rewind: Move backward a large step in the timeline
Localization.Capture countdown move: Reading in {seconds}s. Move the pointer onto the Jianying control…
Localization.Capture countdown hold: Reading in {seconds}s. Keep the pointer still…
Localization.Pointer read failed: Could not read the pointer. Check automation permissions.
Localization.Missing automation permission: Automation permission is missing; mouse adjustment is unavailable.
Localization.Missing screen capture permission: Screen Recording permission is missing, so Jianying's Basic controls cannot be recognized. Enable it for Ulanzi Studio, then restart.
Localization.Basic recognition unavailable: The Basic recognition helper is unavailable. Reinstall the plugin.
Localization.HSL recognition unavailable: The HSL recognition helper is unavailable. Reinstall the plugin.
Localization.Color wheel recognition unavailable: The Color Wheels recognition helper is unavailable. Reinstall the plugin.
Localization.Jianying is frontmost: Jianying Pro is frontmost and ready.
Localization.Switch to Jianying: Switch to Jianying Pro ({target}) before using the dial.
